teaser.en: A floating pond plant with fringed yellow flowers, whose blooms are used in spiritual healing.
teaser.sw: Mmea wa bwawani unaoelea, wenye maua ya manjano yenye pindo, ambayo hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.

summary.en: Toro is a floating-heart, a water plant with round floating leaves and small fringed yellow flowers. It is the Digo 'water lily', and its flowers are used in spiritual healing.
summary.sw: Toro ni mmea wa majini wenye majani ya mviringo yanayoelea na maua madogo ya manjano yenye pindo. Ndilo 'yungiyungi' la Wadigo, na maua yake hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho.

about.en:
*Toro* is an aquatic herb rooted in the mud, with round, heart-based leaves that float flat on the water like small lily pads. The flowers stand just above the surface in clusters of ten to twenty on long stalks. Each is yellow, about 1.5 cm across, with five lobes delicately fringed along their edges.

The Digo identify it by the whole plant and its flowers.
about.sw:
*Toro* ni mmea wa majini uliotia mizizi matopeni, wenye majani ya mviringo yenye kitako cha umbo la moyo yanayoelea bapa juu ya maji kama majani madogo ya yungiyungi. Maua husimama juu kidogo ya uso wa maji katika vishada vya maua kumi hadi ishirini juu ya vikonyo virefu. Kila ua ni la manjano, upana wa takriban sentimita 1.5, na lina ndewe tano zenye pindo laini pembezoni.

Wadigo huutambua kwa mmea mzima na maua yake.

where.en: It grows in ponds, seasonal pools and slow, shallow fresh water, across tropical and southern Africa, including Kenya.
where.sw: Hukua katika mabwawa, vidimbwi vya msimu na maji baridi yasiyo na kina yanayotiririka polepole, katika maeneo ya tropiki na kusini mwa Afrika, ikiwemo Kenya.

uses.en: Pakia records that the flowers of *toro* and of *toro ndide* are used in spiritual healing. He notes that this is unusual, as the Digo seldom pay attention to flowers.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kuwa maua ya *toro* na ya *toro ndide* hutumika katika uponyaji wa kiroho. Anaeleza kuwa jambo hili si la kawaida, kwa kuwa Wadigo mara chache huyazingatia maua.

culture.en: Most Digo plant identification relies on leaves, bark and fruit, not flowers. Pakia lists *toro* among the few exceptions, plants whose flowers matter because of how they are used.
culture.sw: Utambuzi mwingi wa mimea kwa Wadigo hutegemea majani, magome na matunda, si maua. Pakia anaitaja *toro* miongoni mwa mimea michache isiyofuata kanuni hii, mimea ambayo maua yake yana umuhimu kwa sababu ya jinsi yanavyotumika.

names.en: Pakia records *toro* as the Digo name for the water lily in general, with this species as the plain, unmarked *toro*. The smaller *toro ndide* (*Nymphaea* sp.) is named in relation to it. No English or Swahili name is recorded; botanists call the genus floating-hearts.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *toro* kama jina la Kidigo la yungiyungi kwa jumla, na spishi hii ndiyo *toro* ya kawaida isiyo na kivumishi. *Toro ndide* (*Nymphaea* sp.), iliyo ndogo zaidi, imepewa jina kwa kulinganishwa nayo. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huita jenasi hii *floating-hearts*.

reason.en: the small toro, a water lily
